author: kiwi654321
body:
Hello staff I am writing to appeal my infraction of a permanent ban I believe I deserve 1 final chance for the following reasons. Nothing I said was to be taken in a aggressive or hurtful manner towards my friends. I now understand how serious and malicious what I said could of been interpreted by a third party such as yourself. I now understand from what your were reading it seems like I was being very aggressive and mean,but I promise you that BmB was not effected  same goes for Rememes. Although I cannot say that he was in our teamspeak,you are going to have to trust me on this and that he was not effected by what I said as we are very good friends,I am sure that you can have both of their words on this.I don't recall insulting anyone else however if I did I really regret this action and apologise for what I said if they've taken offence to it.
Now I realise that my infractions and history with the server have been less the adequate ( and this is putting it lightly I know), Any infractions I receive from now regarding my behaviour I take full blame for, So I plead with you to have the privilege of playing on your server once more, This is my last chance and I will respect any decision you make of this.
i'm sorry.
Ciaran.
